20	            by_ticker.setdefault(row.ticker, {})[row.date] = row.close
21	    tickers = tuple(sorted(by_ticker))

23	        return Prices(dates=(), tickers=(), closes={})

25	    all_dates = {date for closes in by_ticker.values() for date in closes}
26	    dates = tuple(sorted(date for date in all_dates if date >= start))
27	    closes = {ticker: _fill(ticker, by_ticker[ticker], dates, max_gap) for ticker in tickers}
